thread:
emma: Quick heads-up — TrustedPath (AcmeFin) POC kickoff scheduled Mon 10am PT. Need to lock down: final RFI answers, data residency note for EU, and pricing tiers for a 4-week POC. I uploaded the RFI draft (rfi_trustedpath_v2.pdf) to Google Drive. :paperclip:

raj: Got it. I can take the security questionnaire (section on KMS/HSM + network isolation). Do we need FedRAMP language or just SOC2/ISO?

emma: For now SOC2 + ISO, but they asked if we can support FIPS-compliant KMS in a private deployment. Please call that out as "Available via Private + HSM integration".

sally: I'll do the pricing matrix and POC acceptance criteria. Quick question: do we price POC as reserved capacity or as usage-based with a minimum? Marcus — any guidance from past financials?

marcus: For mid-market finance deals we typically propose a hybrid: a 1-month reserved window (committed vCPU/GPU) + overage at hosted rates. Suggest: 50% discount on reserved commit for POC if they convert to 12mo Dedicated.

raj: Security Q note: network topology question — they want a diagram for private deployment peering + NAT egress controls. I'll paste a minimal config snippet for the RFI:```yaml
vpc_peering: true
private_subnets:
  - 10.0.1.0/24
  - 10.0.2.0/24
kms: customer_managed
hsm: optional
egress_restrictions: true
```

emma: Nice. Also include our standard Data Processing Addendum blurb (we have EU data residency + SCC fallback). Link: https://redwood.example.com/dpa

raj: One more: they asked about live failover — we support multi-region active-passive routing for Dedicated; fallback to hosted model variants if capacity constrained. I'll add the model-variant fallback line.

sally: Pricing draft uploaded: drive/TrustedPath/price_matrix_v3.xlsx. POC tiers proposed: Starter (2xA10s equiv) = $6k/week reserved, Scale (4xA10s equiv) = $11k/week, Add-on: HSM +KMS integration one-time $8k. Comments?

emma: That looks reasonable. Add a note that we can convert POC reserved to a 3mo trial credit if they sign enterprise within 30 days. Helps the close.

marcus: Confirming legal ok on conversion credit. I'll loop in contracts after we finalize pricing line-items.

ops-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://tasks.example.com/TP-POC-231. Items: infra prep, secrets, audit logs enabled, perf baseline run, smoke tests. ETA 48h once we have signed NDA.

raj: For the RFI attachments section, I will include: network diagram PDF, snippet of config (above), our SOC2 attestation link, DPA link, and a short runbook for support during POC (SLA weekdays 9-5 by default).

emma: Great. Action items: raj — finalize security answers by EOD Thu. sally — finalize pricing + acceptance criteria by Fri morning. marcus — confirm conversion credit language with legal. I'll prepare the POC kickoff invite and forward the Drive links to AcmeFin.

sally: One tiny ask: acceptance criteria should include latency SLO (p95 < 120ms gen), throughput (sustained 100 requests/min) and quality gates (no more than 3% regression on eval set). Will attach eval report template.

emma: Perfect. I'll call out those numbers in the RFI. Thanks team — ping me if anything blocks. :rocket:
